arc: Sophie's family bakery is about to be seized by loan shark Victor Hale because of her brother Leo's debt. Billionaire Damien Black needs a wife within 30 days or his grandmother Margaret will give control of Black Industries to his scheming cousin. He offers Sophie a one-year contract marriage: no love, separate rooms, he pays the debt. Then his ex-fiancée Isabella returns, and Victor turns out to be connected to Damien's cousin. Season plan (8 parts): 1 the deal in the rain and the contract; 2 the wedding where Isabella appears; 3 living together – rules broken; 4 Margaret sees through the act but approves; 5 Isabella frames Sophie with fake photos; 6 Victor kidnaps Leo to force Sophie to steal company files; 7 Damien chooses Sophie publicly; 8 Damien tears up the contract and proposes for real.
